sections.heading: You're not losing clients on service. You're losing them on the phone.
sections.text: THE PROBLEM You're not losing clients on service. You're losing them on the phone. Your front desk is excellent when they're free. sections.heading: Answers instantly. Books on its own.
sections.text: HOW IT WORKS Answers instantly. Books on its own. Runs quietly in the background across both channels your clients actually use to reach you. 01 A message or call comes in WhatsApp or phone, picked up instantly, any time of day. 02 The AI has a real conversation Understands the service requested, asks natural follow-up questions, never sounds scripted. 03 Checks your calendar live Offers real open slots only, no double-bookings, no back-and-forth. 04 Books and confirms automatically The appointment lands on your calendar the moment it's agreed, no manual entry.
